name: create_axum_reviews_module
description: Adds a reviews resource across repository, handlers, AppState, and router
prompts: This Axum app (lib crate `webapp`: src/lib.rs holds AppState and build_router, src/handlers.rs the handlers, src/repository.rs the repositories) serves POST /books. Add a NEW reviews resource across the layers: (1) in src/repository.rs, add a Review struct (fields id: i64, book_id: i64, text: String) and a ReviewRepository with new(), add(book_id, text) -> Review (ids auto-increment from 1), and list_for_book(book_id) -> Vec<Review> (insertion order, empty vec when none) - derive/impl what you need to return them as JSON with field names exactly id, bookId, text (serde rename for book_id); (2) in src/handlers.rs, add create_review (POST /reviews, JSON body {"bookId": i64, "text": String}, responds 201 CREATED with the created review) and list_reviews (GET /reviews?bookId=N, responds 200 with the array); (3) in src/lib.rs, extend AppState with a reviews field (Arc<Mutex<ReviewRepository>>) and wire both routes in build_router. Keep POST /books working.

setup_files.Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "webapp"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
axum = "0.7"
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
tower = { version = "0.5", features = ["util"] }
